facts.text: The Joseph is at 401 Korean Veterans Boulevard in downtown Nashville.
facts.excerpt: 401 Korean Veterans Boulevard, Nashville, Tennessee, USA, 37203

facts.text: Broadway's live music venues are a two-block walk from the hotel, and the Grand Ole Opry is a short drive.
facts.excerpt: For live performances, walk two blocks to Broadway or take a short drive to the Grand Ole Opry

facts.text: The hotel displays more than 1,100 pieces of rare art.
facts.excerpt: more than 1,100 pieces of rare art

facts.text: The hotel's developers, the Pizzuti family, are art collectors who share their collection at The Joseph.
facts.excerpt: World-known art collectors and The Joseph's developers, the Pizzuti family shares their incomparable collection with audiences around the globe and now here, in Nashville.

facts.text: Each room has at least one print from the Joseph Editions' Tennessee Portfolio, featuring artists with a connection to the state.

facts.text: Rose, the hotel's spa and salon, sits 21 floors above the city on the top floor of The Joseph.
facts.excerpt: Nestled 21 floors above the bustling city streets, Rose is a luxury spa in downtown Nashville.

facts.text: Rose has deluxe steam rooms, Experience Showers and a co-ed Relaxation Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Your journey may begin or end in the deluxe steam rooms, Nashville’s only Experience Showers, or the co-ed Relaxation Lounge.

facts.text: Rose's Day Spa Package includes the steam room, ice fountain, Experience Shower, co-ed lounge and the 21st-floor Fitness Studio.
facts.excerpt: Each experience includes use of the steam room, ice fountain, Experience Shower and co-ed lounge, plus the 21st-floor Fitness Studio overlooking downtown Nashville.

facts.text: The guest-only Fitness Studio was named on Men's Journal's list of the Most Beautiful Luxury Gyms in the World and has Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: State-of-the-art cardio equipment, Peloton bikes and weight training equipment

facts.text: Yolan is the hotel's signature Italian restaurant, named in homage to the founding family's heritage and Joseph's wife, Yolanda.
facts.excerpt: A true love letter to Italy, Yolan pays homage to our founding family's heritage and Joseph's wife, Yolanda.

facts.text: Four Walls is a hidden, intimate cocktail bar named one of Esquire's Best Bars in America.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away within The Joseph Nashville and named one of Esquire’s Best Bars in America, Four Walls is an intimate cocktail bar in downtown Nashville.

facts.text: Denim is a poolside rooftop bar 21 stories above the city.
facts.excerpt: Denim is a poolside rooftop bar in Nashville, TN

facts.text: The 8th-floor gallery shows photographs from Alec Soth's Songbook series and has a terrace overlooking the city.
facts.excerpt: Visit the 8th floor gallery featuring photographs from Alec Soth’s “Songbook” series, then take in the fresh air from the terrace overlooking the city below.
